stage: A worker's conversation in the NativePeers pane, with a field to message it; the report written in words
scope: The np mod: the pane's worker list and conversation view (rows from the activity log, a live follower, a message field sending a person's follow-up through the bridge), /np open falling back to that conversation, the report's closing lines with one handle, no separate closing text in a handback run, error toasts in words. The desktop app run needs the person after install.

finding.observed: Desktop check after PR #37 (Auto, engine 2.1.309), 2026-10-30 11:49 PM EDT. The pane's Resume cmd answered 'No resume command: Error: Worker has not released its native writer'. The Background tasks view showed the transcript with no field to message the worker and hides finished runs. The transcript showed the final text twice, the second time with worker, group, task, native and artifact ids. The pane's buttons ran past its width while the worker ran. The worker (gpt-6.1-sol, low) answered 'one file: README.md' after running `rg --files -g '*' -g '!*/**'`, which lists only top-level regular files; the folder also holds tally/, tests/ and .git/.
finding.cause: A worker in its follow-up grace still holds its native conversation, so no resume command exists yet. The desktop app draws no main view and its Background tasks have no input (X17). It shows a handed-back report as the run's last message beside the shadow's own closing line (X19). The wrong answer is the worker's reading of 'files' and does not involve NativePeers: the bridge relayed its command and output unchanged.

limitations: The desktop app run is verified only by the person after install; harness runs draw the pane on the terminal surface.
A pane follow-up's result is delivered natively: a desktop parent has no inbox, so it stays in NativePeers and in the pane conversation rather than reaching the main conversation.
The engine flags every handed-back np report as unreviewed (X19), and a parent model may check the result again.
The desktop app shows the Agent call's prompt, including the np header, at the top of the Background tasks transcript; the worker itself receives only the brief.
The pane's Patch preview button (spec 7.9) is not built.
During a long worker run the engine's agent_summary side requests name the shadow's unserved model and fail without content (X18).

independent_review.reviewer: codex gpt-6.1-sol xhigh, NativePeers analysis worker (read-only)
independent_review.note: The reviewer read source and traced sequences; it ran no test suite or harness. The three fixes in 02d75c4 came after the last review round: the 32-input worker budget was spent, so they are verified by tests and probes only.

findings.summary: Message and tool rows were keyed by item alone; providers reuse item ids across generations, so a follow-up's answer could join an earlier row.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb: rows keyed by generation and item

findings.summary: Showing A, then B, then A again could leave A loading forever, and a late send could start or overwrite a conversation no longer shown.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb and ed71167: openConversation and activation start the conversation; a follower reads it each round and ends when another worker's is shown

findings.summary: After a reload a shown conversation was not followed again.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb: activation follows ui.viewing

findings.summary: A failed or uncertain send lost the message, and retyping it could admit a second copy.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb and ed71167: per-worker drafts keep the text and request id; a refusal returns it to the field, an uncertain answer offers Retry under the same id

findings.summary: Final-answer matching compared against clipped text and every generation, so long answers showed twice and another generation's identical answer could be hidden; itemless final candidates repeated streamed text.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb: full-text match within the generation; itemless final candidates matched

findings.summary: A malformed plan event stopped the conversation on the same page indefinitely.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb: each event applied separately; a failure becomes a note and the cursor advances

findings.summary: The live recovery harness waited for removed footer strings.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed9f0bb and ed71167: the live harnesses wait for the current closing lines in either case and record a timeout instead of a milestone

rounds.result: F001, F003, F005 and F006 resolved; F002, F004 and F007 partly.

findings.summary: A follower could still re-initialize the shown conversation between two reads.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed71167: a follower never starts a conversation and ends when another worker's is shown

findings.summary: One provider-name pattern stayed case-sensitive and the footer waits ignored a failed wait.
A second send replaced the single draft, and an earlier answer could clear a newer draft.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed71167: drafts per worker, settled only by their own request id, one unresolved message per worker

findings.summary: A reload could strand a draft in 'sending'.
findings.disposition: FIXED in ed71167: activation turns a surviving 'sending' draft into 'uncertain', with Retry

rounds.result: Not run: the reviewer's logical task-turn limit (2) was reached; input not executed (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED). A fresh reviewer took the final round.
F007 resolved; F002, F008 and F009 partly, with three narrower races.

findings.summary: Activation read a cached selection and then reset the transcript, which could replace a conversation opened in between.
findings.disposition: FIXED in 02d75c4: one conversation per worker (state family); showing one never writes another

findings.summary: The one-message check and the draft reservation were separate updates, so two quick sends could both go out.
findings.disposition: FIXED in 02d75c4: reserveDraft checks, reserves and clears the field in one update

findings.summary: Interrupted drafts were settled only after a successful bridge start.
findings.disposition: FIXED in 02d75c4: settled at activation before the bridge starts
